findings.summary: Save now commits immediately, so the schedule is only shown after saving; this likely breaks any part of the spec that relies on the owner previewing the schedule before confirming a goal change.
findings.evidence: "Invokes operation.goal.save as soon as Save is activated, without a separate review step" / "After saving, SchedulePreview shows the new due date and which past events now qualify"
